items.text: Explain what Amazon Bedrock is and how it differs from training your own model
Describe why IAM roles are used instead of hardcoded API keys for EC2-to-Bedrock communication
Explain the role of Boto3 as the AWS SDK and what it does under the hood
Define what a daemon is and name the one installed in this session
Describe the three parameters temperature, top_k, and top_p and what each controls
Explain what RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) is and why it's preferred over fine-tuning for current data
Launch an EC2 instance with correct AMI, instance type, and security group settings for a web server
Create an IAM role for EC2 with AmazonBedrockFullAccess and attach it to an instance
Connect to an EC2 instance via EC2 Instance Connect and run Linux commands
Install and enable Apache httpd, Python 3, and Boto3 on Amazon Linux 2023
Create and edit files with vi editor (i to insert, Esc then :wq to save)
Set correct file permissions with chmod for CGI scripts and directories
Make a successful API call to Amazon Bedrock from a Python CGI script
State the hard API Gateway timeout limit and its implications for multi-model workflows
Identify the correct AWS region for this exercise and explain why region matters for Bedrock
Explain the Shared Responsibility Model in the context of OS patching on EC2
